Ruling: letter A · maintainer 「A 按会话,修工具」 (the option he chose on the decision card) · recorded 2026-11-16T12:57Z

Recorded by the project's decision thread for this question. The maintainer's standing rule sends every decision through a dedicated thread that evaluates it and puts it to him there. He chose at 2026-11-16T12:56:16Z. Decision thread `cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X6jK1tbN5Z4LeiwEuDZZeoi`, card `cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X613Wn2SX7kNtF3q8xyKHZP`, choice record `cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1XWtHcXCuSydnawM4dWBtQpe`. Analysis: `/mnt/project-files/pm-orders/review/l2-independence-decision-analysis.md` (project files).

Recorded on this seat post because the question was raised by this seat and an L2 seat's current state lives on its post; no card carried it. The tool-fix card this ruling asks for cites this comment as its Ruling-ref.

## The question he was asked

「确认契约审核的独立性按会话算、不按账号算吗?」 May an L2 seat review a PR that its own account dispatched or implemented, when the reviewing session is not the implementing session?

The three options on the card, as he read them:

- 「A 按会话,修工具」: 「同账号的审核席可以审本账号的 PR,只要审核会话不是开发会话。规则不动,立卡删掉工具里的账号禁令。今天已出的记录都有效。」 (recommended)
- 「B 按账号,改回规则」: 「审核席不审本账号的 PR。本项目车道的 14 个 PR 全归 review#1,review#2 今天的 5 条记录要重审,规则改回 11-15 之前。」
- 「C 按账号,逐线程放行」: 「默认禁止,您在每条审核线程亲口说一句才放行。工具读不到这句话,报表会一直显示被禁。」

## The ruling

**A. L2 independence is judged per session. `references/lanes/l2-review.md` line 20 governs as it stands on `main`: 「记录恒带 `Implemented-by:`/`Reviewed-by:` 对,两会话相异;⛔ 不限账号,派发账号亦可坐。」 The account bar in `scripts/pm/check-owed-reviews.mjs` is stale and is to be removed.**

⛔ Not taken: B (it reverses the rule the maintainer set on 2026-11-15 and leaves the lane's own tier review allowed while a dedicated same-account L2 seat is not). C (the wording of PR #33943, replaced the same day; the tool reads GitHub only and can never see the per-thread word, so `barred` would print forever).

## What the thread found and told the maintainer before he chose

1. **This was ruled once already; the tool lagged.** PR #29967 (2026-11-03) wrote the account bar into the charter and into the tool. Card #34007 quotes the maintainer at 2026-11-15T15:59Z: 「定复审席必须由另一个账号来坐 没有这个规定」, then 「是skills的问题吗？应该立卡修改」. PR #33938 rewrote the charter line to today's text. The tool was not changed; PR #34058, merged later that day, added the area-lease note on top of the superseded wording. PR #34052's body notes the mismatch and names a carrier that closed with #33938. The thread read the quote on card #34007 only, not the original chat, and said so; the maintainer chose A with that stated.
2. **What independence guards, and what an account adds.** Fresh eyes come from a different session and a fresh review agent briefed without the drafter's conclusions; the tier is proven by `verify-review-tier.mjs`; self-approval of contract and security changes is stopped by the Tier H human approval. None of the three reads the account. A second account adds only separate project memory, which the thread named as a small residual and did not audit on review#2's briefs.
3. **Consistency.** `contract-review.md` 送审路由 lets a lane that reaches `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` review its own PRs, and card #34376 restates it. A dedicated L2 seat on the same account is further from the author than that.
4. **Measured.** `node scripts/pm/check-owed-reviews.mjs` at 2026-11-16T12:36Z: 27 PRs owe a contract review, 14 rows print `barred review#2`.

## After the ruling

1. review#2 keeps taking PRs of `os-project-manager` seats; its records of today (#34353, #34355, #34358, #34359, #34162) and their deltas stand, and #34347 continues. No re-review.
2. Until the tool is fixed, a `barred review#2` mark (and the same mark on any L2 seat for the account reason alone) is read as a known stale mark; it stops no seat. Rows the tool prints `unjudged` for the account reason read the same way.
3. review#2 files one `domain:skills` card through the filing gate (③ maintainer-directed, Ruling-ref this comment): remove the account bar, `ownAccountsOf`, the `barred` and `unjudged` seat states and `AREA_LEASE_BAR_NOTE` from `scripts/pm/check-owed-reviews.mjs` with their self-test cases; rule text unchanged. Dependency: PR #34393 (card #34376) rewrites `takerOf` in the same file and carries the bar forward, so the fix lands after it or rides it if the skills seat prefers.
4. No rule text changes: `l2-review.md` line 20 already says it.

## Effort of the chosen letter

The skills lane, one PR, `scripts/pm/check-owed-reviews.mjs` and its self-test only (`scripts/pm/**` is not a governed path). Nearest precedent: PR #34058, +30/−6 in that one file. No precedent for the removal itself.

## Four facets

os-decision-facets
① 项目长远合理性: A leaves one rule in one place (reviewing session differs from implementing session, stated on the record) and removes the one exception B and C would keep: a lane may review itself at the tier while a same-account dedicated seat may not.
② 实际业务拉动: hit today; 14 of 27 owed PRs, all driven by this account's lane seat, offered review#1 alone while review#2 was opened for that load.
③ 防 AI 犯错: after A the report means what it prints. C trains seats to ignore a standing `barred` line. Every option fails loudly: the record names who reviewed.
④ 创业阶段不扩散: A deletes code (the bar, the unjudged state, the note). B keeps it; C adds a waiver carrier.
Prior rulings read: 不限账号, 本账号, barred, account → 4 hits (#29967, #33943, #33938 with card #34007, #34058); ADR none; thread: none
